summary: Keep learning target/support identity and ranked accepted recall evidence current, enforce native MCP local-state boundaries and truthful helper hints, and retain generated provider origins.
reason: Published Carstay optional learning and MCP paths must preserve their actual evidence and state effects: explicit target updates, retained generalized support and actual cached resource identity matter independently of provider planning. Foreign generated-client redirects must stop before inherited headers leave the configured origin.
validated_outcome: Actual teach-pattern reporting, storage and verified recall agree; later inference preserves explicit payload. Transactional undo retains and refreshes supported exact/prefix patterns after scanning all retained members and filtering compatible supporters, removes unsupported families and rolls back failures. Cached alias conflicts, including an ambiguous query bridging different canonicals, remain mismatches; true aliases and warned missing-resource fallback survive. Native MCP reads create no implicit state, five intentionally writable learning readers have explicit false read-only hints, and named string inputs preserve scalar/variadic boundaries. Foreign redirect transports never receive configured/per-call headers; existing same-origin, binary and streaming contracts remain. Compatible distinct supporter cohorts survive stale/conflicting/missing/multi-entity outliers; examples come only from supporters and dropping to one compatible binding retires the rule. Synthesized exact and unique-prefix targets are checked against only the actual bound entity, including canonical aliases; unrelated query aliases cannot repair a target conflict. Valid bound identities and identifier-only unknown-cache fallback remain. Recall validates and deduplicates pattern candidates before its emitted-result cap, so limit one does not suppress a lower-ranked valid binding; standalone Apply default/explicit caps remain. Actual non-dry fixture CLI reads and HTTP resolver preserve stale store, journal and cache bytes; response caching and refresh guards are exercised. The obsolete foreign-credential restamp helper is removed. One pattern tries later existing targets after identity rejection; valid duplicates consume its binding only after identity validation. Best typed-target evidence retains partial-to-exact upgrades and direct exact priority. Final emitted targets are removed from mismatch alternatives before their cap, preserving rejected-only namespaces and missing-resource teaching evidence. Ranked lazy pattern validation preserves final confidence-before-score order, reads one cached identity for limit one among twelve or thirty valid patterns, and preserves standalone score-first and default/explicit caps. Debug mode may continue reading for rejected evidence. Cached-resource cancellation and unexpected SQL/Scan failures propagate through direct and pattern Recall; only sql.ErrNoRows retains warned missing-row fallback, and genuinely unknown existing identities keep their prior scoped behavior. Actual function-backed and NULL-payload SQLite views prove verified IDs do not turn unreadable payloads into exact success. Resource type and ID are distinct comparable tuple fields in result, accepted and diagnostic maps. Actual optional teach/Recall preserves both delimiter-bearing pairs (a|b,c) and (a,b|c), and an accepted tuple cannot erase a different rejected tuple with the same joined text. Only positive boost teachings from the existing eligible source whitelist support inferred patterns, both during initial extraction and retained-family reconciliation. Actual hide/alias_of teachings remain stored but cannot retain, become examples of, or recreate a synthesized positive rule. Two surviving genuine positives retain the same rule and valid example; source eligibility and transaction/manual/unrelated guarantees remain.
